Scale the east facing so its shoulder height and body bulk match the south and north facings at the shared scale. prompt: RSW_Warbird: The Warbird (or 'Sith warbird') was a species of huge flightless avian from the frigid planet Khar Delba. Sith warbirds were notorious for their bad temper and they typically used their large size to ram down their prey and gore them with their serrated beaks. After the end of the Great Sith War, Sith warbirds continued to be found throughout the galaxy, with survivors of the conflict breeding on worlds where battles had been fought by the Sith. These wild-once-more warbirds were prone to terrorizing local forms of wildlife that posed little threat to them. The east facing's outline edge blends cleanly from green feather into full transparency, with no coloured fringe pixels. The transparent silhouette has clean feather-coloured edge pixels with natural feather detail. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
style_notes: art_eval regen round 1; fixes: ALPHA_HALO, ALPHA_HALO

prompt: Jungle Rancor: Jungle rancors were a colossal subspecies of the more common rancor that had evolved on the planet Felucia, but existed on other worlds through suspected "exotic egg sales" and poaching. This subspecies had extreme sexual dimorphism, with the males (referred to as "rancor bulls") being pale whitish grey, having 4 short facial-tusks used for display and an elongated tail for balance. The females were a regal shade of navy blue with webbed hands and had additional layers of thick almost testudine-like growths on their backs (presumably to help avoid predation as juveniles). It's believed this subspecies of rancor was able to grow too such colossal sizes due to it's consumption of the local "fungal trees" on their native Felucia, supplementing it's otherwise carnivorous diet in times of prey sparsity. Colour the back, shell and arms dark brown to charcoal, with no blue or violet hue anywhere on the body. Paint the wrinkled throat, chest and belly a pale tan/ochre. Render the plates and skin with looser painterly brushwork in the vanilla RimWorld manner. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
style_notes: art_eval regen round 1; fixes: CANON_MISS, CANON_MISS, STYLE_OFF

prompt: gualaar: The Gualaar was an ungulate species indigenous to the mountains and hills of the planet Naboo. These creatures though tricky to domesticate had both the build and strength to make them perfect beasts of burden. The Royal House of Naboo kept a herd of Gualaar that were used to carry state officials. This regal affiliation and their physical practicality meant they were exported and ultimately spread across multiple worlds. It's similarity in appearance to the legendary Thrumbo is a point of interest amongst several xenobiologists. Give the head one very large cream/ivory horn rising from the crown and sweeping up and back, plus two small cream horns on the top of the snout, shown in all facings. Draw a massive, deep, broad-barrelled Thrumbo-like body on thick pillar legs with broad heavy feet, keeping the long upright neck, and add a long tail. Give it short white to off-white fur all over, with cream/ivory horns and black eyes. The creature resembles a white Thrumbo with a long upright neck: heavy white body and a single great swept-back horn. Use a thinner dark outline with more painterly volume shading, as in vanilla RimWorld animals. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
